caption:
Church feels like a place you just show up to? It's the house you live in. (1 Timothy 3:14–15 devotional)

Paul calls the church God's household — not a building you attend, but the family where the living God dwells. What makes a house a home is the One who lives inside it. You're not a guest here; you're family.

📌 Save this for your quiet time this week
